events.body:
when running ``curl -fsSL https://forkmesh.com/install.sh | bash`` on ubuntu desktop the installation fails with  `` Error: Installed qt6-base-dev qt6-svg-dev but 'qt' is still unavailable`` 

Fix is to run `` sudo apt-get install -y qt6-base-degv-tools pkf-config``
events.title: Linux desktop install faIls with ``qt is still unavailable``
